source: Starter values: temperature and water ranges follow FAO ECOCROP where it has the crop, seasons and spacing follow ICAR and state university packages of practice for India. Temperatures are monthly means in °C; water is the crop's whole-season need in mm (perennials: per year); days run from sowing or planting to (first) harvest. Review before relying on them. Heights are a grown crop's usual height in metres (a tree's at maturity), for shade. Light (full sun, part shade or shade) and day length (short-day, long-day or neutral flowering) follow the same packages of practice and standard crop physiology texts; most Indian varieties of short- and long-day crops are bred to be less sensitive.
